, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the age comparison logic. Although the data gathered were correct (Reginald Le Borg born 1902, Hervé Bromberger born 1918), the Planner concluded that 1902 indicates a younger director than 1918. This led to the wrong final answer; the younger director is Hervé Bromberger (1918), so the correct film is Figaro-Ci, Figaro-Là.
